title: 下班
warn: A haunted night shift that ends in a gentle goodbye. A death long ago is remembered, with no gore. It ends safe at dawn.

series.next: Season one is over. The store has a new rule, in your handwriting: 别让人一个人等。

setting: The convenience store, your sixth night, 5:40 am. The sky over the car park is going grey.

steps.narr: Tonight 老韩 isn't on the screen. He's behind the counter, beside you: an old man in a red raincoat, very tired.
5:59. At the door: 庞经理, in a 1998 uniform that's too big for him now.

else.narr: 庞经理 isn't coming. You have his words on a sticky note, word for word.

steps.en: A handover has to be done properly. Count the till first.

steps.narr: The 1998 money, one more time: three hundred-yuan notes, two tens, seven ones, and a fifty-fen coin.

say.en: Count the till aloud, and give the total.
answers: 一共是三百二十七块五。
say.gloss: Three hundred and twenty-seven yuan fifty in all.
say.tip: 三百二十七块五 = ¥327.50, the same as night four.

answers: 我数好了，一共三百二十七块五毛。
4.gloss: I've counted it: three hundred and twenty-seven yuan fifty.

steps.narr: 庞经理 picks up the pen with a shaking hand, and writes his own name on the blank line.

else.narr: You write 庞经理's name on the blank line, the way he asked you to.

steps.narr: The handover form. Read the line aloud.
steps.zh: 交班人：老韩。接班人：庞经理。

answers: 交班人老韩，接班人庞经理。
交班人，老韩。接班人，庞经理。
say.gloss: Handing over: 老韩. Taking over: 庞经理.
say.tip: 交班人 hands the shift over. 接班人 takes it.

ok.narr: The line isn't blank any more.

answers: 交班表上写着：接班人，庞经理。
4.gloss: The form says: taking over, 庞经理.

steps.en: 老韩, I've come to take over.

else.narr: You read 庞经理's note aloud, word for word.
else.zh: 老韩，我来接班了。对不起，我来晚了。

steps.en: I'm sorry. I came too late.

steps.narr: On the CCTV, only two people now. The rules sheet beside the till is blank.

say.en: Say goodbye: 老韩 can clock off now.
say.gloss: 老韩, you can clock off now.
say.tip: 下班 xiàbān = finish work, clock off. 可以 = may, can: you're allowed now.

ok.narr: He takes off the red raincoat, folds it, and lays it on the counter. When you look up, he isn't there.

alts.en: Give him his change, one last time

then.narr: You put three coins on the counter, the way you did on night two.
He smiles. Then there are only the fridges, three coins, and the light coming in.

then.en: 老韩's last words were 不用找了。 You keep the three coins in your pocket, always. Season one ends here. 🌅

answers: 老韩，交班做完了，您可以下班了。
4.gloss: 老韩, the handover's done. You can clock off now.

steps.zh: 下个月排班，你还上夜班吗？
steps.en: Next month's rota: are you still doing nights?

say.en: Keep working nights, or move to days.
say.tip: 夜班 yèbān = night shift. 白班 báibān = day shift.

ok.en: Good. With you on nights, I can stop worrying.

alts.gloss: I'd like to move to days.

then.en: All right. See you in the daytime.

answers: 我还上夜班，店里得有人在。
4.gloss: I'll stay on nights. Someone has to be here.

answers: 我想上白班了，晚上想睡觉。
alts.gloss: I'd like to move to days. I'd like to sleep at night.

steps.en: You stay on nights. At three every morning, you make a hot soy milk and leave it on the counter. Season one ends here. 🌅

else.en: Your first day shift: sunlight, schoolkids, noise. A folded red raincoat on the hook in the back. Season one ends here. 🌅
